reviews.text: I really enjoyed trying the DANONGWON Daily Kombucha. The lychee flavor is refreshing, fruity, and pleasantly sweet. I especially like that it feels light and easy to drink, making it a great choice for a refreshing drink during the day. The taste is very enjoyable and makes it easy to include in my daily routine. I also love the convenient format, which makes it perfect to have at home or take with me when I’m out. Overall, I’m very happy with the product and would definitely recommend it to anyone who enjoys fruity kombucha and refreshing drinks. The lychee flavor is definitely my favorite!
reviews.zh: 我好享受飲 DANONGWON Daily Kombucha。荔枝味清爽、有果香，甜度好啱。我特別鍾意佢口感輕盈，易飲，所以係日間飲一杯好清爽嘅飲品都好啱。味道好好，令我每日都容易飲。我亦鍾意佢方便嘅包裝，喺屋企飲，或者外出時帶住都好方便。總括嚟講，我好滿意呢款產品，會推薦畀所有鍾意果味康普茶同清爽飲品嘅人。荔枝味絕對係我最鍾意嘅！

reviews.text: I really enjoy this kombucha! 🥰 It’s convenient to have as part of my daily routine, and I love that there are so many different flavors to choose from. 💕 The taste is refreshing and easy to enjoy, especially when I want something light and flavorful. The variety pack is a big plus because I can try different types! ✨
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款康普茶！🥰 佢融入我每日嘅生活好方便，而且我好鍾意有好多唔同口味可以揀。💕 味道清新、易飲，尤其係當我想飲啲清淡、有味道嘅嘢嗰時。多款裝大受歡迎，因為我可以試吓唔同口味！✨

reviews.text: I absolutely love this kombucha! 😍 I’ve tried different flavors from this brand and honestly enjoy all of them. They’re so refreshing, tasty, and easy to drink. I love having one whenever I want something flavorful and refreshing. Definitely one of my favorites and I’ll keep buying it! ✨💕
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款康普茶！😍 我試過呢個品牌嘅唔同口味，老實講都好鍾意。佢哋好清爽、好好味、好易飲。每當我想飲啲有味道、清爽嘅嘢，我都會飲一支。絕對係我最鍾意嘅之一，我會繼續買！✨💕

reviews.text: This kombucha is a convenient and enjoyable way to add probiotics to your daily routine. The flavor is refreshing, mixes easily, and makes drinking more water throughout the day much more enjoyable. I like that it contains probiotics, prebiotics, and fructooligosaccharides while being sugar-free. The individual sticks are practical for travel, work, or keeping in a bag for a quick refreshing drink anytime. 🍉✨🥤
reviews.zh: 呢款康普茶係一個方便又好飲嘅方法，可以將益生菌加入你每日嘅生活。味道清爽，容易攪勻，而且令你日間飲多啲水變得更加有趣。我鍾意佢有益生菌、益生元同果寡糖，而且無糖。獨立包裝方便旅行、上班，或者放喺袋入面，隨時可以即時享受一杯清爽嘅飲品。🍉✨🥤

reviews.text: This is my second purchase of this DONONGWON kombucha (different flavor though; I bought the yogurt first). They have so many interesting flavors, it almost feels like a lucky box whenever I try a new one. They converted me into a kombucha drinker. The sachets are very convenient, so I can just make them anywhere essentially. The fizz and the coolness definitely fed my soda itch. As for the flavor, I like them, though I will say that I like the yogurt better than the new one I bought (Moro blood orange); granted, it did take me time to really like yogurt, so I might end up liking this one better eventually.
reviews.zh: 呢次係我第二次買呢款 DONONGWON 康普茶（但係口味唔同，我之前買咗優格味）。佢哋有好多有趣嘅口味，每次試新嘅都好似開盲盒咁。佢哋令我變成咗康普茶愛好者。條裝好方便，我幾乎可以喺任何地方即時沖飲。嗰陣氣泡同冰涼嘅感覺，好似滿足咗我想飲汽水嘅癮。至於味道，我都鍾意，不過我會話我比較鍾意優格味，多過新買嗰款（摩洛血橙）；不過，以前我都要花時間先鍾意優格，所以我最終可能會更喜歡呢款。

reviews.text: This kombucha tastes so good – I got the watermelon version and it’s super fruity and refreshing! I love that it comes in powder sticks, which are easy to carry and dissolve well in water. It’s also sugar-free and packed with probiotics and prebiotics, making it perfect for daily digestion support. Bonus: the cute bottle was a nice free gift!
reviews.zh: 呢款康普茶好好味！我買嘅係西瓜味，超級果味同清爽！我鍾意佢係粉末條裝，易攜帶，又好容易溶喺水入面。佢仲係無糖，並且含有益生菌同益生元，對日常消化好有幫助。附送嘅可愛樽係一個好好嘅驚喜！

reviews.text: I’ve already drunk have of it! I got the apple flavor and it tastes really nice. The bottle is super convenient for mixing and drinking right away. I’ve been combining this kombucha with other teas, and I can genuinely feel an improvement in my digestion. Definitely going to repurchase!
reviews.zh: 我已經飲咗一半啦！我買嘅係蘋果味，味道好好。個樽好方便，可以攪勻，即刻飲。我一直將呢款康普茶同其他茶混埋飲，而且我真係感覺到消化有改善。一定會再買！

reviews.text:
I love it! Lychee is definetely one of my favourite fruits and I think the drink is close enough to the actual taste. It is easy to make and really tasty. I feel like I am not going to stop drinking it, specially with the summer coming close. 
The bottle is handy, as it makes easy to measure the water and then mix it by just shaking the bottle.
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意！荔枝絕對係我最鍾意嘅水果之一，我覺得呢款飲品好接近真正嘅味道。好易整，而且好好味。我覺得自己會好想一直飲，特別係夏天快到嘅時候。
個樽好實用，好容易量水，然後搖一搖樽就可以攪勻。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
